domain_vs_fixture_label_policy: Official domain fields use spec enums only (Fact types: PROBLEM|ACTION|TECHNOLOGY|RESULT|ROLE|METRIC; Atom statuses: SUPPORTED|USER_CONFIRMED|UNSUPPORTED|STALE; computed SOURCE_VERIFIED). All DRAFT_* and legacy test taxonomy labels live inside fixture_test_classification (TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY_NOT_DOMAIN_API) and MUST NOT be read as API/DB domain enums.

provenance_and_freeze_preconditions.spec_sync_basis: Orchestrator-transmitted B-002 / Grounded Claim Pipeline / DB Model / Option C / T-004A / T-004B / REF-06..08 / CLAIM-05,06,08 / ADR-018 criteria (direct Notion read unavailable; unconfirmed API/DB details explicitly marked REVIEW_REQUIRED).
provenance_and_freeze_preconditions.family_split_anti_leakage_rule: All cases, edited versions, and refetch fixtures sharing an evaluation_family_id or source revision remain locked inside the same partition (SYNTHETIC_REGRESSION_DEV or SYNTHETIC_REGRESSION_TEST), preserving all v0.3.0 DEV/TEST boundaries.
